item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, University of Campania Luigi Vanvitelli

This multi-journal collection brings together research on entrepreneurship as a mechanism for addressing significant global challenges. It welcomes contributions that examine entrepreneurship phenomena across different analytical levels and explore how entrepreneurial activities can shape future outcomes.

The collection is open to researchers, practitioners, and policymakers investigating entrepreneurship from various perspectives, including its internationalization, organizational contexts, and societal implications. Submissions are accepted on an ongoing basis across three participating journals: Journal of International Entrepreneurship, International Entrepreneurship and Management Journal, and Journal of Global Entrepreneurship Research.
